summary: Cellebrite DI Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Thomas E. Hogan ceased serving as Chief Executive Officer effective August 13, 2026, pursuant to mutual agreement. Shiven Ramji was appointed CEO as part of planned succession. Hogan also resigned from the board and will serve as a six-month advisor. The filing is an advance notice of an abrupt, agreed leadership transition rather than a routine meeting notice. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors were disclosed. The change is effective immediately. Watch for strategic direction under Ramji and potential impact on the company's digital intelligence products. This is a clean management transition event, with the CEO departure being the primary special situation.
